whatItFakes: What a household keeps back for its next rent or mortgage before buying everyday living counts the members' gross daily wage until the payment is due; the payroll's withholding is not netted out, so a household whose take-home pay barely covers its home keeps back a little too little.
why: The fix for a household that paid its home on its living day and set the payment aside a second time (world-household-everyday-living-unpaid-first-month); the cost-of-living engine reads each member's job wage, and the take-home pay is only known to the payroll when it pays.
replacement: The members' take-home pay due before the next living day, from the payroll's withholding (withholdingFor, src/core2/tax-withholding.ts) or the pay last received, read by housingKeptBack in src/core2/cost-of-living.ts.
